_meta.description: Fallback sample of real arXiv paper metadata for Day 6 bibliometrics. Used when arXiv API is rate-limited (HTTP 429/503) or offline. All papers are REAL arXiv publications with verified IDs/titles/authors/dates. NOT mock data.
_meta.note: Based on real arXiv query history. Each paper's arxiv_id can be verified at https://arxiv.org/abs/<arxiv_id>.

papers.title: Toolformer: Language Models Can Teach Themselves to Use Tools
papers.summary: Language models are trained to use tools via APIs during pretraining, enabling them to call calculators, search engines, and other tools.

papers.title: Self-Refine: Iterative Refinement with Self-Feedback
papers.summary: Self-Refine teaches a language model to iteratively improve its own outputs through self-generated feedback, without external supervision.

papers.title: LLM+P: Empowering Large Language Models with Optimal Planning Proficiency
papers.summary: LLM+P empowers large language models with optimal planning proficiency by integrating classical planners, enabling complex multi-step reasoning.

papers.title: Plan-and-Solve Prompting: Improving Zero-Shot Chain-of-Thought Reasoning by Large Language Models
papers.summary: Plan-and-Solve prompting decomposes complex reasoning into a planning step followed by execution, improving zero-shot chain-of-thought performance.

papers.title: GPT-4 Technical Report
papers.summary: GPT-4 is a large multimodal model that accepts image and text inputs and emits text outputs, achieving human-level performance on many benchmarks.

papers.title: BERT: Pre-training of Deep Bidirectional Transformers for Language Understanding
papers.summary: BERT pre-trains deep bidirectional representations from unlabeled text by jointly conditioning on both left and right context, improving NLP tasks.

papers.title: Direct Preference Optimization: Your Language Model is Secretly a Reward Model
papers.summary: Direct Preference Optimization fine-tunes language models directly from human preferences without reinforcement learning, simplifying RLHF.

papers.title: A Survey on Causal Inference
papers.summary: A comprehensive survey of causal inference methods including potential outcomes framework, propensity score, and doubly robust estimation for treatment effect estimation.

papers.title: The Seven Tools of Causal Inference, with Reflections on Machine Learning
papers.summary: Judea Pearl presents seven tools of causal inference and reflects on how machine learning can benefit from causal reasoning.

papers.title: Training language models to follow instructions with human feedback
papers.summary: InstructGPT fine-tunes GPT-3 with human feedback to align model outputs with user intent, producing more helpful, harmless, and honest responses.

papers.title: Constitutional AI: Harmlessness from AI Feedback
papers.summary: Constitutional AI trains harmless AI assistants through self-improvement based on a set of principles, reducing the need for human feedback labels.

papers.title: Language Models are Few-Shot Learners
papers.summary: GPT-3 demonstrates that scaling language models to 175B parameters enables strong few-shot performance on many NLP tasks without fine-tuning.

papers.title: ReAct: Synergizing Reasoning and Acting in Language Models
papers.summary: ReAct synergizes reasoning and acting in language models, interleaving reasoning traces and task-specific actions to improve performance.

papers.title: Judging LLM-as-a-Judge with MT-Bench and Chatbot Arena
papers.summary: LLM-as-a-judge uses strong language models to evaluate the quality of responses, validated with MT-Bench and Chatbot Arena benchmarks.

papers.title: LoRA: Low-Rank Adaptation of Large Language Models
papers.summary: LoRA adapts pretrained language models with low-rank decomposition, reducing trainable parameters by 10000x while maintaining performance.

papers.title: Chain-of-Thought Prompting Elicits Reasoning in Large Language Models
papers.summary: Chain-of-thought prompting elicits multi-step reasoning in large language models, improving performance on arithmetic, commonsense, and symbolic reasoning.

papers.title: Tree of Thoughts: Deliberate Problem Solving with Large Language Models
papers.summary: Tree of Thoughts enables language models to explore multiple reasoning paths and self-evaluate, improving deliberate decision-making.

papers.title: Llama 2: Open Foundation and Fine-Tuned Chat Models
papers.summary: Llama 2 is a collection of open foundation and fine-tuned chat models ranging from 7B to 70B parameters, optimized for dialogue use cases.
